text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Gah!? Y-You bastard...!
You're seriously planning to put me in another race?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
What's with you, seriously, scarin' the—
N-No... makin' me just a teeny-tiny bit
surprised, dammit...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...This girl does nothing 24/7 but think
about making me run...
She's a fighting freak, or rather a racing freak...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Espoir City looks this way with eyes full of suspicion
and fear... It might be best to hold off on entering
any races for a while...
